rows.title: Glaukos: IDose TR Plus Cataract Surgery Delivers Superior Eye Pressure Reduction In Phase 4 Trial
rows.description: (RTTNews) - Glaukos Corporation (GKOS) reported positive topline results from a Phase 4 prospective randomized, controlled study evaluating iDose TR administered alongside cataract surgery in patients with open-angle glaucoma (OAG) or ocular hypertension (OHT).

rows.title: Glaukos Reports Positive Phase 4 Results For IDose TR With Cataract Surgery
rows.description: (RTTNews) - Friday, Glaukos Corporation (GKOS) announced positive topline results from a Phase 4 study evaluating iDose TR in combination with cataract surgery in patients with open-angle glaucoma (OAG) or ocular hypertension (OHT).
